description: Star Wars RPG — NPC and dialogue data structure. All NPC objects in zone.npcs must conform to this shape.

NPC.id: string — globally unique slug across ALL zones and planets (used as key in completedInteractions Set)
NPC.x: integer — grid column (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
NPC.y: integer — grid row (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
NPC.kind: string — portrait type, must be registered in NpcPortrait() function
NPC.label: string — display name shown in dialogue header and action log
NPC.prompt: string — dialogue text shown to player on first interaction
NPC.repeatPrompt: string — text shown in action log when player walks into NPC after interaction is complete
NPC.choices: array of DialogueChoice — minimum 2 choices recommended for moral tension

DialogueChoice.text: string — option text shown in dialogue UI (prefixed with '>' in render)
DialogueChoice.morality: integer — delta applied to alignment.morality; engine clamps to -100..+100 total; use negative for dark side, positive for light side

loyalty.description: Object with optional faction keys. Omit keys that have no loyalty change for this choice.
loyalty.republic: integer (optional) — delta applied to loyalty.republic; engine clamps to 0..100
loyalty.sithEmpire: integer (optional) — delta applied to loyalty.sithEmpire; engine clamps to 0..100
loyalty.underworld: integer (optional) — delta applied to loyalty.underworld; engine clamps to 0..100

DialogueChoice.result: string — outcome text added to action log after choice; this is the only feedback the player gets so make it specific

PortraitKinds.note: To add a new kind, ask the Systems Architect to add an SVG branch to NpcPortrait() before writing any NPC that uses it.

MoralityGuidelines.light_side: Typically +5 to +18 per choice. Reporting crimes, helping the vulnerable, refusing bribes, protecting innocents.
MoralityGuidelines.dark_side: Typically -5 to -20 per choice. Accepting bribes, enabling criminal activity, threats, deception for gain.
MoralityGuidelines.neutral: 0. Purely pragmatic or observational choices with no moral dimension.
MoralityGuidelines.tension: Each NPC should ideally offer one choice that trends light and one that trends dark. Both choices with the same sign create no moral stakes.
